title: Attitudes and Feelings of Doctors Caring for Their Colleagues: a Qualitative Study in Picardy
brief_summary: The sick doctor is a patient apart. His right of prescription and his knowledge of semiology easily lead him to self-medication.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Practicing general practitioners, registered with the Order, caring for or having treated other doctors whatever their specialties

Exclusion Criteria:

* No
